Campus life

Athletes, artists and leaders in the making

Boarding, sport, arts, robotics, riding and more across 174 acres.

The campus

Spaces to wander

Drag to explore →

01

Boarding & care

Dormitories

Fully renovated; a delicate balance between home and school so your child feels safe, happy and welcome.

Dining hall

Renovated hall for 300 diners; five meals a day with menus designed by a dietician.

Prayer hall

Call to prayer five times a day; basic Islamic education and Quran recitation are emphasised.

Sick bay

A trained nurse on campus 24/7, regular doctor visits and in-house care.

Akbar Peerbhoy Sports Stadium

The largest sports ground in town, with separate grounds for football, kabaddi, volleyball and basketball.

Green campus

Rainwater harvesting and organic gardens across 174 acres of flora and fauna.

02

A day at Panchgani

  1. 01Rise & prayPrayer hall, Quran recitation and breakfast.
  2. 02ClassesDigital classrooms, labs and practicals.
  3. 03Lunch & restDietician-planned meals in the dining hall.
  4. 04Games & clubsSports, arts, robotics, riding, archery.
  5. 05Study & wind downPeer tutors and the dorm in-charge.
03

Activities

  • Robotics & AITinkering lab — introduced in 2024.
  • Basic AviationA new 2024 course.
  • Agriculture & gardeningOrganic gardens and hands-on farming.
  • Horse ridingOn-campus riding.
  • Archery & shootingArchery range and shooting range.
  • Sky gazingClear hill-station skies.
  • Team sportsCricket, football, hockey, volleyball, basketball, kabaddi, athletics.
  • FitnessPT, gymnastics, yoga, open gym and a skating rink.
  • Pottery & ceramicsStudio work with clay.
  • Music & choirMusic rooms and an annual musical choir.
  • Drama & storytellingInter-house dramatics and storytelling.
  • Knitting & sewingCraft and creative expression.
  • Debate & JAMInter-house debate and Just-a-Minute.
  • Quiz & spell beePrimary, Islamic and general quizzes.
  • Community serviceService opportunities and World NGO Day.
  • Hifz courseAvailable on demand.
04

The student journey

  1. 1

    Arrive & settle

    Orientation for new students, a welcome assembly and the dorm in-charge as the first point of contact.

  2. 2

    Build foundations

    Study habits, reading and core subjects, with peer tutors, advisors and regular unit tests.

  3. 3

    Explore passions

    Robotics, riding, archery, debate, pottery and sport — inter-house contests let every child shine.

  4. 4

    Rise to the board year

    Preliminary exams, practicals and one-to-one goal setting for Std X and XII.

  5. 5

    Launch

    NEET, JEE, CET, NATA and CA guidance, the Annual Day prize distribution and a farewell.
